    A Relaxing Way to Explore the Windy City

    Take a trip to the Windy City for an experience you’re not likely to forget. Featuring exquisite Lake Michigan, an array of lively neighborhoods, and an out-of-this-world culinary scene, the city is a world-class destination with a wide variety of things to see, taste, and explore near the best hotels in Chicago.

    Whether you want to stay just steps from Magnificent Mile or you're looking for the inviting sandy views of Montrose Beach, we have a premier selection of top hotels in Chicago to suit your travel needs. Get ready to treat yourself to a slice of Chi-Town's famous deep-dish pizza, so deliciously thick it's typically eaten with a fork and knife.

    Enjoy premium service at the top Chicago hotels

    When you’re ready to relax and recharge, our top Chicago hotels have accommodations and amenities to make you feel right at home. Start every morning with a complimentary breakfast or a made-to-order breakfast at select locations. Depending on where you stay, you can look forward to a sparkling indoor pool or a stunning outdoor pool that features breathtaking views of the city’s bold architecture. Some locations are in historic or boutique hotels and feature an impressive design style that’s sure to impress. Check the details of your reservation for other Hilton amenities, such as on-site dining or pet-friendly accommodations.

    Fill Your Days in Chicago, Then Rest Easy With Us

    Chicago is a city that knows how to have a good time and a good meal. Catch a ballgame and grab a Chicago-style hot dog at beloved Wrigley Field, home of the Cubs. Explore downtown for a quintessential city experience strolling along lush gardens and magnificent buildings around the historic Museum Campus. See some animals in the city at Lincoln Park Zoo for a fun family-friendly visit full of interactive exhibits. Finally, no trip to Chicago would be complete without visiting Cloud Gate, otherwise known as “The Bean.” The monumental outdoor art piece is a permanent installation whose shiny exterior reflects the city's impressive skyline and surrounding greenery. Whether you want to stay just steps from Magnificent Mile or you're looking for the inviting sandy views of Lake Michigan, we have a premier selection of hotels in Chicago to suit your travel needs.

    Uncover Iconic Chicago, Then Unwind Your Way

    Check out some of the most exciting locations around Chicago hotels for a complete experience. Head north to Evanston to stroll along the prestigious Northwestern University campus and shop at eclectic, independent boutiques that line the streets of downtown Evanston. If you’re visiting with the family, make sure to take a drive to Naperville for a trip to the Naper Settlement. An outdoor museum that recreates prairie life, Naperville is definitely a great way to spend an afternoon. Another popular choice is Aurora. Shop ‘til you drop at the premium outlet and malls in Aurora, plus catch a movie at one of the cinemas in the charming city.

    FAQs

    What are the most popular seasonal tourism activities to do in Chicago?

    Chicago is known for dramatic weather, so outdoor activities can vary depending on the season. But no matter what time of year you’re visiting, you can always find something to keep you busy in the Windy City.

    •If you’re here in the winter, check out the Christkindlmarket to sip some spiced drinks and shop gifts for loved ones.

    •Spring is a popular time for fests, like St. Patrick’s Day. See the city celebrate and turn the Chicago River green for the holiday.

    •During the summertime, Chicago has festivals and events almost every weekend. Visit art fests or attend a music festival like Lollapalooza.

    •Get to know the city during Open House in the fall. This architecture tour is a great way to see some hidden gems in the city, including rarely opened halls and buildings.

    What are some kid-friendly outdoor activities in Chicago?

    •If you’re traveling with the family, you can find plenty of kid-approved activities in Chicago.

    •Get into the competitive spirit of the city and check out a game with both MLB teams in the city. Check out Rate Field to see the White Sox play, then head to the north side to visit Wrigley Field for a Chicago Cubs game. Make sure you try an iconic Chicago hot dog to feel like a real local.

    •Take the El train to teach little ones about the wonderful world of trains. Depending on when you’re visiting, you might be able to catch Santa and his elves on his seasonal train rides.

    •Head to Museum Campus to visit places like the Adler Planetarium or the Shedd Aquarium to spend an afternoon learning some fun out-of-this-world facts together. This neighborhood has several prestigious museums and legendary exhibits.

    What are some fun couple activities in Chicago?

    •Chicago can be a great destination for a romantic getaway whether you’re visiting for the first time or the hundredth. Check out some of the special things to do to make some magical memories.

    •Go for a walk or rent a bike on the Lake Front Trail. Situated right next to sparkling Lake Michigan and complemented by the stunning Chicago skyline, the trail is a great way to spend a morning before indulging in Chicago’s excellent dining scene.

    •Catch a show at the Chicago Theatre. Famous for its dramatic Chicago sign, this gorgeous theatre features painted ceilings and an opulent atmosphere, regularly hosting concerts, comedians, and other entertaining events.

    •Snap a selfie at Cloud Gate. A unique art installation, Cloud Gate is a mirrored “bean” placed right in the center of Millennium Park. Head to this popular tourist destination to partake in one of Chicago’s traditions.
